name: Design
description: We start with the problem, not the pixels — research, flows, and prototypes that get tested on real people before a single screen is polished. What leaves this phase is a product people already understand.

name: Develop
description: The same team that designed it builds it, so nothing is lost in translation. Clean, well-tested code on a stack your own engineers will actually enjoy inheriting — shipped in small, visible increments.

name: Maintain
description: Launch is the start, not the finish. We stay on for the unglamorous work that keeps products good: monitoring, updates, performance budgets, and a roadmap that reflects what users actually do.
